- [LDET.1.4] **Live mode.** The event trace is generated on the fly
  from real-world events: sensors fire, adapters respond,
  clocks tick, external processes write shared state. The
  event trace itself varies between runs — wall-clock
  timing is different, adapter responses depend on external
  systems, concurrent writers race. **Live output is
  non-deterministic**, and correctly so. The language's
  guarantee isn't violated; it simply doesn't apply to
  "run the same scenario live twice and get identical
  output" — that would require the world to stand still.
